title: OMP native Session and standalone ACP bridge
implementation: Use direct native Session RPC for Ait OMP. Introduce a standalone Rust ait-omp-acp CLI with stdio, logging and exit handling; ACP conversion and native RPC remain in provider. Remove aitd omp-acp and the in-process ACP client. Reserve _omp/rpc for external ACP capability negotiation. Preserve legacy handles/history/aliases without rewriting logs; reapply sandbox on create, restore and config reopen. Only launch user-installed OMP, never bundle/download its SDK or Bun. Align bridge version with desktop macOS/Linux builds, archives, signing/notarization and release asset verification.
acceptance: Native create/restore/config reopen and legacy handles/history work without a second writer; standalone CLI interoperates over stdio with correct logging/exit and sandbox behavior; unsupported negotiation downgrades explicitly. Packaging/version/signing/notarization/archive verification must pass for all required platforms before delivered. Missing macOS/Linux packaging or required signing/notarization evidence is an incomplete acceptance blocker, never an alternative success condition; no release performed.

required: affected fmt/clippy/build/tests and runtime smoke for changed backend
affected SDK/UI/protocol checks and documented old-host/client downgrade
